title: Micah
author: Micah of Moresheth.
historicalSetting: Micah condemns injustice and false worship while promising a ruler from Bethlehem and future restoration.
keyVerse: Micah 5:2 — "Out of you one will come out to me that is to be ruler in Israel."
christFocus: Micah points clearly to Christ as the ruler born in Bethlehem who shepherds God's people in strength.
